impact: One isolated Edge Function, no imports from application, no configuration or schema edits. Only auth.admin.updateUserById(fixedUUID, {password}) writes.
configuration_rules: Use existing managed service credentials without disclosure. Operator must be the verified owner administrative identity, distinct from target. Capture target updated_at immediately before arming. Expiration at most 15 minutes. Never commit actual runtime values.
scope: Fixed synthetic UUID and tenant, synthetic app_metadata and tenant metadata, active owner membership. Verify administrative operator via Auth getUser and server user_roles. Never accept public key or decoded client claims as authorization.
external_blocker: Lovable capability inquiry umsg_01m1yffg9dfdca6m0sj1t3c3fr queued, queue_paused=true, queue_pause_reason=hitl_tool. No direct edge deploy/delete tools advertised to Codex. Secure password input and independent teardown are not confirmed.
before_deployment: Resolve existing Lovable human interaction; do not approve GitHub/main changes
Confirm deployment from this reviewed branch without repo mutation or preview rebuild
Confirm secure administrative authentication and password delivery without chat/code/logs
Confirm independent removal and verification capability
Require applicable audit checks on exact branch head to pass
execution: Verify absent function name before unique deployment
Compare nonsecret identity, metadata, roles and membership evidence before/after
Deploy only reviewed code with JWT verification enabled
Owner supplies password through supported secure mechanism; no browser automation submits final password-change action
Invoke once, no automatic retry on timeout or ambiguous outcome
In finally, delete function and task-specific runtime configuration even on validation failure; preserve shared service credentials
Verify function absent and endpoint unavailable
Authenticate synthetic identity via secure form and validate explicit tenant context
limitations: Busy/attempted guard is per isolate; not a distributed lock
updated_at guard rejects changed baseline but is not atomic compare-and-swap
No distributed exactly-once guarantee; one external invocation is a required operational control
No persistent data or provider tests performed
